name: dsh-steward
description: Steward for DeepSeek Harness: seven role charters injected at dispatch time (no user-selectable agent presets), a Steward panel in the Web GUI (agent graph, session links, per-role model/effort config), per-role routes from <project>/steward.config.json over the panel settings, the Agent Teams shared task board as the run dashboard, and a /steward command.
